Ashley R: Last-call: hotfix PR #5221 needs 2x LGTM to go in tonight's patch. Cutoff 23:59 PT. I resolved merge conflicts with main; CI is green on linux, failing one macOS flake currently.

Matt H: Link?

Ashley R: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5221

Sanjay P: I'll do a security/passive review now. ETA 20m.

Olivia C: FYI I'm on meetings until 22:30, but can do a quick test pass after that. If someone can do code/ops review that'd help.

Kai L: Can run the smoke deploy and confirm perf numbers. Will run in ~15.

qa-bot: CI macos-job #78: flaky-network-test failed; re-run suggested.

Matt H: I can take code review after Sanjay. If Sanjay ok with approach I'll give LGTM.

Sanjay P: Left a small comment about nonce handling; nothing blocking. Approving once that's addressed.

Ashley R: comment addressed and pushed. Thanks @Sanjay P.

Matt H: LGTM from me on quick pass. @Kai L can you confirm smoke? If smoke passes and @Olivia C doesn't object, @deploy-bot can you hold merge until 2x LGTM + CI green?

Kai L: Smoke done — perf within tolerance. No regressions.

Olivia C: Quick run looks good to me.

deploy-bot: Scheduled merge window open until 00:15 PT. Waiting for 2 approvals and final CI status.

Ashley R: That's 2x LGTM — please merge when CI finishes, @deploy-bot or @Matt H if deploy-bot needs manual.

deploy-bot: CI status: all checks passed. Merged and release pipeline started. :tada:

Matt H: Thanks everyone. Will monitor release page for any anomalies.

Ashley R: Appreciate the quick turnaround. Tagging release notes: hotfix/5221.
